CBI arrests multiple officials in separate bribery and fraud cases

The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has arrested several individuals, including an IPS officer, a retired IAS officer, and a Haryana man, in connection with separate cases. The arrests involve allegations of bribery, a large bank scam, and a cyber fraud involving digital arrest threats. These actions highlight ongoing investigations into corruption and financial crimes across different levels of public service and civilian life.
